stem.text: The diagram shows a junction in a circuit where three wires, P, Q and R, meet. The currents in P and Q are $1\,\text{A}$ and $3\,\text{A}$ respectively, in the directions shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a junction marked by a dot where wire P from the left meets wire Q (upper right) and wire R (lower right). Arrows on the wires show direction; printed labels: P, Q, R, 1 A on P, 3 A on Q.

stem.text: How much charge passes a given point in wire R in a time of $5\,\text{s}$?
